name: A fingerprint of every American recall notice
what: One row per campaign: the first eight characters of a SHA-256 of each of the three text fields NHTSA publishes, the day we first read it, the day we last read it, and how many times we have seen the text move.
attribution: Recall wording is published by NHTSA and is US Government public domain. The fingerprints and the dated record of when each one changed are CarsMultiverse.
